title: AdCode Customer Config
description: Per-customer configuration for a single MCP server instance. Paths are relative to the config file's directory.

customer_slug.description: Stable human-readable identifier for this customer (e.g. acme-marketing).

account_id.description: Facebook ad account ID in act_XXXXXXXXX format.

campaigns_dir.description: Directory containing campaign JSON files, relative to this config file. Defaults to 'campaigns'.

state_dir.description: Directory for state files, relative to this config file. Defaults to 'state'.

email_addresses.description: Approved inbound sender addresses for this customer. Emails from any other address are rejected.

operator_email.description: Operator address that receives plan-review emails and sends GO/HOLD replies.

bot_email.description: From address used for all outbound emails (e.g. traffic@ryanbishop.me). Must be a verified Resend sender.
